title: Breakfast
description: Hannah French presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

title: Saturday Morning
description: Tom talks to legendary violinist, Christian Tetzlaff about his career as a violinist and his mission, not to entertain, but to reveal the beauty and innate depth of music.

title: Earlier... with Jools Holland
description: Jools is joined by the jazz singer and lyricist Norma Winstone.

title: Key Changes: Radio 3's Essential History of Classical Music
description: 1875, Paris. Two groundbreaking operas pull the artform in radically different directions.

title: Record Review
description: Andrew McGregor with a look at the week's classical music releases and recommendations from Sarah Walker.

title: Sound of Cinema
description: Edith Bowman presents your weekly showcases of striking screen music. This week, composer Chris Roe joins to discuss the soundtrack to Austin Powers in 'Harmonising Hollywood'.

title: This Classical Life
description: Jess Gillam is joined by the pianist, band leader and composer James Pearson for a listening party.

title: Opera on 3: Don Giovanni
description: Mozart's Don Giovanni: murder, revenge and the supernatural in a dazzling performance featuring the Scottish Chamber Orchestra from the 2026 Edinburgh International Festival.

title: Music Planet
description: Lopa Kothari presents the best in folk and roots-based music from around the world, with picks from Kronos Quartet founder David Harrington.

title: New Music Show
description: New European Ensemble perform works by four female composers inspired by the four Seasons novels by Scottish author Ali Smith, recorded at Aberdeen Sound Festival.

title: Through the Night
description: Anastasia Kobekina is the soloist in Dvorák's Cello Concerto with the NDR Elbphilharmonie Orchestra and conductor Karina Canellakis from the Schleswig-Holstein Music Festival.

title: Breakfast
description: Mark Forrest presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

title: Sunday Morning
description: Join Sarah Walker for a glorious Sunday mix, with lush romantic symphonic yearning, crisp baroque brilliance and a fishy Sunday Sequence.

title: Private Passions
description: Poet and writer Helen Mort shares her musical passions with Michael Berkeley.

title: Music Map
description: Genius - or elevator music? Sara Mohr-Pietsch explores the musical landscape surrounding Erik Satie's Gymnopédies, with diversions to Ancient Greece and to Mozart's Musical Joke.

title: Music Matters: The President and the Polka
description: Justin Webb (Today and Americast presenter) explores the surprising relationship between classical music and American political history. The rise of the city orchestra and opera.

title: Jazz Record Requests
description: Alyn Shipton presents jazz records of all styles as requested by you, including music from Count Basie, Dianne Reeves, Jelly Roll Morton and more.

title: The Early Music Show
description: The Gonzaga Band presents songs & duets from the age of Monteverdi, together with the winning compositions from the 2026 NCEM Young Composers Award in partnership with BBC Radio 3.

title: Choral Evensong
description: Live from St Martin-in-the-Fields to mark the 300th anniversary of the completion of the building of the Church, including music by Nils Greenhow, Klatzow and Cecilia McDowall.

title: Between the Ears: The Most Alive Sounds
description: New Zealand-born composer and sound artist Annea Lockwood has spent a lifetime listening very closely to sounds in her environment that, for most of us, slip by unnoticed.

title: Sunday Feature: New Generation Thinkers shorts
description: Storm Jameson was President of the campaigning writer's group English PEN between 1938 and 1944 when refugees were fleeing across Europe and when she wrote The Moon Is Making.

title: Words and Music
description: Arguing gods, quarrelling composers and sibling rivalry: Pooky Quesnel and Andonis Anthony read poems and prose on the theme of feuds and arguments from the petty to the deadly.

title: Brass Banding with Hannah Peel
description: Bollywood tradition meets brass bands in Erollyn Wallen's Gold Saturday, and Thierry Deleruyelle commemorates a French mining disaster.

title: Night Tracks
description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch presents an adventurous, immersive soundtrack for late-night listening, from classical to contemporary and everything in between.

title: Unclassified
description: Elizabeth Alker shares genre-defying music; and Irish singer Seamus Fogarty takes to the Unclassified listening chair to choose a track that transports him elsewhere.
